name: pho-algorithmic-audit
description: Solve Public Health Observatory (PHO) reproducible / transportability / robustness / mediation audit tasks that ship an analysis_request.json plus an answer_template.json and require pulling evidence only from the read-only PHO web portal named in environment_access.md (<TASK_ENV_BASE_URL>). Use whenever a task asks for a "registered audit", "algorithmic transportability audit", "six-module audit", "robustness gates", "controlled decision/classification", release/revision resolution, cohort construction, or deterministic statistical modules (fixed effects, ridge/elastic-net nested CV, wild cluster bootstrap-t, split/grouped conformal, trajectory PCA + k-means, GMM, Shapley, partial-R2 sensitivity) whose result must be returned as ONE JSON object conforming to a supplied answer template.
